title: Rejestr kontrybucji diecezji poznańskiej z 1561 r. (digital edition)
author: Edition by Bogumił Szady
institution: Lublin Historical Database (LHDB), Catholic University of Lublin; Bogumił Szady, tagging by Łukasz Poznański
notes: TEI edition of the register of the double contribution imposed on the clergy of the Poznań diocese in 1561, from two copies kept in the Archiwum Główne Akt Dawnych, Warsaw (ASK 91 and a fragment in ASK 3), with page images. The whole TEI file is served at the data link. Status active: the project site is maintained (events listed for 2026) and the app runs a recent TEI Publisher release; no date of last change to the edition itself is given. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
